explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at every D2 except when the agent chose a1 and commonly reached S1. Then it is high (8-10) if the previous trial was unrewarded, especially right after an a2 trial or an unrewarded run; medium (3-7) if the previous trial was a rare transition or was unrewarded after a rewarded a1 trial; and near 0 (0-2) if the previous trial was rewarded, more so after several rewarded a1 trials in a row.
